name: [🎃] 📱 Build a Phone Empire
desc:
📱 Start in a garage in 2007 and build the biggest phone company in the world.

🎨 DESIGN every device yourself: screen size, cameras, corners, buttons, colour, finish and logo. Pick the parts, set the price and hand it to your team.

🏗️ BUILD your office your way: walls, doors, floors, paint, desks and decorations, from a garage to a Headquarters.

👥 HIRE a team. Your Roblox friends show up as candidates and work in your office as their real avatars.

🔬 RESEARCH new tech year by year and unlock tablets, smartwatches, earbuds, foldables, laptops, AR headsets and drones.

🚀 LAUNCH with a marketing campaign, read the critics' reviews and watch sales come in live. Beat rival companies and expand into new regions.

🏆 COMPETE on the global leaderboards, then sell your company and start again with a permanent Legacy bonus.

✅ 28 goals with cash rewards
✅ Plays on phone, tablet, console and PC
✅ Your company saves automatically

👍 Like and favourite to follow updates!
